simple.meaning: עָלַע (ʻâlaʻ) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to sip up.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in Job, beginning at Job 39:30. The surrounding contexts include blood.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to עָלַע (H5966) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: עָלַע (ʻâlaʻ) / H5966 is traced through Job 39:30 with source-language evidence and verse context.
